lines.en: Look at this plate. What shape is it?
It is round. It is a circle.
Good. And this box?
It is a square. It has four straight sides.
lines.ko: 정사각형이에요. 곧은 변이 네 개 있어요.

lines.en: Yesterday you drew a triangle. Where is it?
It is on the wall. Look at the point.
The table is flat. Put the picture in the center.
Can I draw a line here?
Sure. Tomorrow we will draw more shapes.
lines.ko: 그래요. 내일은 모양을 더 그릴 거예요.

lines.en: I will draw a big circle for you!
Hello. Can you tell me about this painting?
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 이 그림에 대해 말해 줄 수 있어요?

lines.en: Sure. What shapes do you see?
I see a big circle in the center.
Yes, that is the sun. Do you see the line?
The straight line is the road. It is long.
Right. And the houses are small squares.
The roof looks like a triangle.
Last month a child found ten triangles here.
lines.ko: 지난달에 한 아이가 여기서 삼각형 열 개를 찾았어요.

lines.en: I will look at the other side now.
Enjoy. The flat sea is on the left.
lines.ko: 즐겁게 보세요. 평평한 바다는 왼쪽에 있어요.
